treatments.name: Heart-healthy lifestyle changes
treatments.summary: Heart-healthy eating and exercise are core treatments and can be very effective; some treatment plans include only lifestyle changes.

evidence.quote: Treatments for high blood pressure include heart-healthy lifestyle changes and medicines.
evidence.statement: Treatment includes heart-healthy lifestyle changes and medicines.

evidence.quote: These changes, such as heart-healthy eating and exercise, can be very effective.
evidence.statement: Heart-healthy eating and exercise can be very effective.

treatments.name: Blood pressure medicines
treatments.population: People whose blood pressure is not controlled by lifestyle changes
treatments.summary: Medicines are added when lifestyle changes do not control blood pressure; some people need more than one type.

evidence.quote: But sometimes the changes do not control or lower your high blood pressure. Then you may need to take medicine.
evidence.statement: Medicine is needed when lifestyle changes do not control blood pressure.

evidence.quote: There are different types of blood pressure medicines. Some people need to take more than one type.
evidence.statement: Several types of medicine exist and some people need more than one.

treatments.name: Treating the underlying cause of secondary hypertension
treatments.population: People whose high blood pressure is caused by another condition or a medicine
treatments.summary: Treating the causative condition or stopping the causative medicine may lower blood pressure.

evidence.quote: If your high blood pressure is caused by another medical condition or medicine, treating that condition or stopping the medicine may lower your blood pressure.
evidence.statement: Treating the underlying condition or stopping the causative medicine may lower blood pressure.

notes: Consumer health summary; content attributed on the page to NIH: National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute.
